# HEIC test fixture

`e2e/fixtures/attachment-preview/photo.heic` is the upstream libheif demonstration file
[examples/example.heic](https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/examples/example.heic),
retrieved 2026-11-15. It is used only as a test fixture for the HEIC decoder and is not shipped in
any app build.

Copyright Struktur AG and Dirk Farin. The upstream
[COPYING](https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/COPYING) declares LGPL-3.0 for libheif
and MIT for the sample applications and wrappers. It states no separate license for the image
itself.
